items.title: Michael Moore interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: Harry loved Scott. And we just did a tour in England with the two of them playing together, it was great.

ctx.x: What a concept, you know, and here’s this young guy doing it. He was in his twenties when I met him and he was playing like that. And I really think a lot of it is connected to Ruby Braff. Because Ruby went around bebop in a way. He’s not really bebop. He was a song player, but a modern song player. Even though Louis Armstrong and Hackett, those were his influences. But Ruby harmonically and everything is very advanced and very understanding. But his songs, and I think he was a hero to a lot of these younger guys…
So you think the future of jazz — it still has a future?
